name: RL Unplugged
summary: 覆盖 Atari、DeepMind Control 和机器人等环境的离线强化学习轨迹集合。
summaryEn: An offline-RL trajectory collection spanning Atari, DeepMind Control, robotics, and other environments.
scale: Multiple standardized offline-RL domains and behavior policies
scaleZh: 多个标准化离线 RL 领域和行为策略
access: Datasets available through TensorFlow Datasets and official code
accessZh: 可通过 TensorFlow Datasets 和官方代码访问
verdict: 多环境离线轨迹和奖励信号的统一集合
verdictEn: A unified collection of multi-environment offline trajectories and rewards
wmNote: 跨环境状态-动作序列适合比较世界模型的泛化能力。
wmNoteEn: Cross-environment state-action sequences support world-model generalization studies.

evidence.statement: Unified offline-RL suite provides logged interactions with high-dimensional actions and visual observations; component datasets are not independent of the collection.
